instruction: Same picture, same camera, nothing moves or changes size: only age the linden, the bench and the wall by twenty-five years to late October 2020. The linden keeps its trunk foot exactly where it is in the grass bed, but it is now a big old tree: a much thicker grey-brown trunk with rough bark, and a larger, denser crown of heart-shaped leaves in warm autumn yellow, gold and some green, spreading further to the left and up out of the top edge, with a few leaves falling. The wooden bench stays exactly where it is, now with weathered grey-brown slats. The low red-brick wall stays exactly where it is and as large as it is, now old: darker weathered bricks, some moss and lichen, a stained concrete coping, all twelve grey stones of its panel in place. Keep the yellow distance dashes, the red pipe, the court lines, the school, the hoop and everything else exactly as they are. No people, no text.
